comps_review_2026_10_06.premium_discount: No premium or discount to the 21.7x median, applied to core CY2028 EPS at the horizon. That is a 2.5% discount to GOOGL's own 22.3x core today. For a premium: Cloud +82% with a $513.9B backlog, and top-tier segment margins. Against it: 2027 consensus FCF of -$36.7B, zero buybacks and new equity (10-Q, 8-K), and CY28 EPS growth of +19.7% that is in line with peers (MSFT FY28 +19.7%, META +15.8%, NFLX +19.7%, RDDT +25.2%, APP +25.5% on MarketScreener EPS). The evidence does not show a premium that persists to Oct 2027. agent_1's 21x was a 7% 'premium' to a median biased low by adjusted EPS; on the reconciled basis it is a 3% discount. agent_2's and agent_3's 21.8x is about the reconciled median.
